<?php

namespace SearchIndexer\Service;

use SearchIndexer\Config\FeatureFlags;
use SearchIndexer\Transport\SecureClient;

class IndexingService
{
    private $featureFlags;
    private $client;
    private $endpoints;
    private $verificationMode;

    const VERIFY_PEER = 1;
    const VERIFY_HOST = 2;
    const VERIFY_FULL = 3;

    public function __construct(FeatureFlags $flags, array $endpoints)
    {
        $this->featureFlags = $flags;
        $this->endpoints = $endpoints;
        $this->verificationMode = self::VERIFY_FULL;
        $this->client = new SecureClient();
    }

    public function getVerificationLevel(): int
    {
        return $this->verificationMode;
    }

    private function buildCurlOptions(string $endpoint): array
    {
        $options = [
            CURLOPT_URL => $endpoint,
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 30,
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => [
                'Content-Type: application/json',
                'X-Service: search-indexer',
            ],
        ];

        $this->applyCertificateVerification($options);

        return $options;
    }

    private function applyCertificateVerification(array &$options): void
    {
        $peerVerify = true;
        $hostVerify = 2;

        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('use_internal_ca')) {
            $options[CURLOPT_CAINFO] = '/etc/ssl/internal-ca.pem';
        }

        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('relaxed_tls_for_staging')) {
            $peerVerify = $this->resolveEnvironmentTrust();
            $hostVerify = $this->resolveHostVerification();
        }

        $options[CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER] = $peerVerify;
        $options[CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST] = $hostVerify;
    }

    private function resolveEnvironmentTrust(): bool
    {
        $env = getenv('DEPLOYMENT_ENV') ?: 'production';
        $trustMap = [
            'production' => true,
            'staging' => true,
            'development' => false,
        ];

        return $trustMap[$env] ?? true;
    }

    private function resolveHostVerification(): int
    {
        $env = getenv('DEPLOYMENT_ENV') ?: 'production';

        // Host verification: 2 = verify CN/SAN, 1 = check existence, 0 = none
        // For non-production with relaxed flag, we still verify existence
        if ($env !== 'production') {
            return $this->verificationMode >= self::VERIFY_HOST ? 2 : 1;
        }

        return 2;
    }

    public function indexDocuments(array $documents): array
    {
        $results = [];

        foreach ($this->endpoints as $endpoint) {
            $options = $this->buildCurlOptions($endpoint);
            $options[CURLOPT_POST] = true;
            $options[CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS] = json_encode([
                'documents' => $documents,
                'timestamp' => time(),
                'batch_id' => bin2hex(random_bytes(16)),
            ]);

            $result = $this->executeRequest($options);
            $results[] = $result;
        }

        return $results;
    }

    private function executeRequest(array $options): array
    {
        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt_array($ch, $options);

        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $error = curl_error($ch);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($response === false) {
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => $error];
        }

        return [
            'success' => $httpCode >= 200 && $httpCode < 300,
            'status' => $httpCode,
            'body' => json_decode($response, true),
        ];
    }

    public function healthCheck(): bool
    {
        foreach ($this->endpoints as $endpoint) {
            $options = $this->buildCurlOptions($endpoint . '/_health');
            $result = $this->executeRequest($options);
            if (!$result['success']) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

class FeatureFlags
{
    private $flags;
    private $overrides;

    public function __construct(array $flags = [], array $overrides = [])
    {
        $this->flags = $flags;
        $this->overrides = $overrides;
    }

    public function isEnabled(string $flag): bool
    {
        if (isset($this->overrides[$flag])) {
            return (bool) $this->overrides[$flag];
        }
        return isset($this->flags[$flag]) && $this->flags[$flag] === true;
    }
}
